description: Principles of biomedical devices and instrumentation. Topics include: sensors and transducers (such as voltage sensors, optical sensors, displacement/pressure sensors and accelerometers, and acoustic sensors); signal filtering and amplification (Bode plots, passive and active filters, noise in electrical circuits); data acquisition and signal processing (sampling theory and signal aliasing, analogue-to-digital conversion); ECG; EEG; hearing aids; wearable and implanted devices; instrument/device safety.
